application.label: Application
application.description: Deploy and sync one app from Git.

fields.label: Application name
fields.description: Name of this resource in the Argo CD namespace.

fields.label: Argo CD namespace
fields.description: Namespace where Argo CD watches for this resource.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: AppProject that governs the allowed repositories and destinations.

fields.label: Git repository URL
fields.description: Git repository that contains the Kubernetes manifests.

fields.label: Git revision
fields.description: Branch, tag, or commit that Argo CD reads.

fields.label: Path in repository
fields.description: Directory containing the manifests to deploy.

fields.label: Destination server
fields.description: API server URL of a cluster registered with Argo CD.

fields.label: Destination namespace
fields.description: Namespace for namespaced resources that specify no namespace.

fields.label: Create destination namespace
fields.description: Create the destination namespace during sync if it is missing.

fields.label: Automated sync
fields.description: Sync changes from Git automatically when the app is out of sync.

fields.label: Prune removed resources
fields.description: With automated sync, delete resources that were removed from Git.

fields.label: Self-heal
fields.description: With automated sync, restore the Git state when live resources drift.

fields.label: Delete managed resources with the Application
fields.description: Add the Argo CD finalizer so deleting the Application also deletes its managed resources.

app-project.label: AppProject
app-project.description: Limit where Applications can deploy and which Git repository they can use.

fields.label: Project name
fields.description: Name of this resource in the Argo CD namespace.

fields.label: Argo CD namespace
fields.description: Namespace where Argo CD watches for this resource.

fields.label: Allowed repository URL
fields.description: Repository that Applications in this project may use.

fields.label: Allowed destination server
fields.description: API server URL that Applications in this project may deploy to.

fields.label: Allowed destination namespace
fields.description: Namespace that Applications in this project may deploy to.

application-set.label: ApplicationSet
application-set.description: Generate one Application per environment. Requires a running ApplicationSet controller.

fields.label: ApplicationSet name
fields.description: Name of this resource in the Argo CD namespace.

fields.label: Argo CD namespace
fields.description: Namespace where Argo CD watches for this resource.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: AppProject that governs the allowed repositories and destinations.

fields.label: First environment
fields.description: Name suffix for the first generated Application.

fields.label: Second environment
fields.description: Name suffix for the second generated Application.

fields.label: Git repository URL
fields.description: Git repository that contains the Kubernetes manifests.

fields.label: Git revision
fields.description: Branch, tag, or commit that Argo CD reads.

fields.label: Path in repository
fields.description: Directory containing the manifests to deploy.

fields.label: Destination server
fields.description: API server URL of a cluster registered with Argo CD.

fields.label: Destination namespace pattern
fields.description: Use {{ .environment }} to substitute each environment name.
